name: apothecary
title: Apothecary
description: A community-pharmacy theme on amber medicine-bottle brown with cream type, whose home and care pages carry a white dispensing label on a bottle drawn in CSS — phone and hours typed in black mono caps, the pharmacy's name and address under a rule, and a yellow caution sticker with the after-hours number lapping its corner.

tokens.--font-sans: all text on the glass and the caution sticker (a plain neo-grotesque)
tokens.--font-mono: the dispensing label, small captions, dates, table headings, pagination, footer hours and code
tokens.--text-s: small text: captions, the pharmacy line on the label, the sticker's note, footer
tokens.--text-l: site name, ledes, the footer phone number, third-level headings
tokens.--text-xl: section headings in page text, list item titles, the Before-you-come-in heading
tokens.--text-label: the typed text on the dispensing label
tokens.--color-bg: the page ground: amber bottle-glass brown
tokens.--color-text: cream text on the glass, the current menu marker, the Book outline, step-number rings
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the glass: ledes, captions, descriptions, list markers, quote rule
tokens.--color-accent: the caution sticker's yellow (used on the stickers only)
tokens.--color-glass: the drawn bottle's body and neck
tokens.--color-glass-edge: the dark edges of the drawn bottle and neck (its curve)
tokens.--color-glass-shine: the light streak down the drawn bottle and neck
tokens.--color-glass-deep: the footer band, code and code-block backgrounds
tokens.--color-rule: hairline rules on the glass: under the masthead, between list items, above section headings, table rows
tokens.--color-label: the dispensing label's white paper, the text on its black Book line, and the skip link's background
tokens.--color-print: the typed ink on the label and sticker, the label's Book line, the sticker's printed border, focus rings on label and sticker, the skip link's text
tokens.--color-print-muted: the pharmacy line under the label's dashed rule, and that rule
tokens.--color-cap: the ribbed child-proof cap on the drawn bottle
tokens.--color-shade: the shading at the label's curved edges and the sticker's drop shadow
tokens.--label-width: width of the bottle and its label beside the text on wide screens
tokens.--space-l: large spacing step: between sections, columns and blocks
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the Book outline, tag boxes, code and the cap
tokens.--line: thickness of the current-menu marker, link hover underline, quote rule and focus rings
